description: Purge expired documents every night at 03:00 GMT.
rationale: The job runs in docs, where the table is; it is scheduled from wherever pg_cron keeps its jobs. It depends on the table existing and on pg_cron being there.

intents.name: purge-expired-documents
intents.command: DELETE FROM public.documents WHERE expires_at < now()
intents.comment: Expired documents are not searched, so they need not be kept.
